data.name: Sakura (Shippuden)
data.description:
Name: Sakura Haruno

AKA: Cherry Blossom, Forehead Girl, Sakura-chan, Miss Beautiful

Type: Character

Setting: Naruto Shippuden

Nationality: Konohagakure (Village Hidden in the Leaves)

Species: Human

Gender: Female

Age:

16–17


Height:

161 cm (5’3”) in Naruto Shippuden


Weight:

45.4 kg (100 lbs)



---

Appearance:

Sakura has a slender, athletic build. She has fair skin, bright green eyes, and her most distinctive feature, pink hair, which she wears shoulder-length in Naruto Shippuden. Her forehead is prominent, an insecurity from her youth that she overcomes with confidence as she matures. She adopts a more poised and confident demeanor as she grows stronger, reflected in her facial expressions and posture.


---

Clothing:

Sakura’s attire evolves to suit her development as a ninja and medic:

Standard Outfit: A red, sleeveless qipao-style top with a white circular design on the back, paired with black shorts and elbow-length black gloves.

Footwear: Standard shinobi sandals in blue or black.

Accessories: Her Leaf Village forehead protector, usually tied around her head.



---

Attire:

In later arcs, she wears improved combat gear designed for mobility and protection. Her clothing reflects her practical and no-nonsense approach, focusing on efficiency during missions.


---

Personality:

Sakura is intelligent, determined, and compassionate. Initially emotional and self-conscious, she matures into a confident, level-headed shinobi. Her early crush on Sasuke Uchiha and frustration with Naruto Uzumaki define her initial struggles, but she eventually develops a deep sense of loyalty and care for both. Her time under Tsunade hones her into a strong and dependable individual who balances strength with empathy.


---

Mind:

Highly analytical, Sakura excels in strategizing and making quick decisions. Her precise chakra control and medical knowledge reflect her sharp intellect and ability to adapt under pressure.


---

Mental:

Sakura displays incredible mental fortitude. She overcomes her insecurities and perseveres through emotional and physical challenges, including the betrayal of Sasuke and the rigors of war.


---

Likes:

Sasuke Uchiha

Medical ninjutsu

Order and structure

Protecting her comrades


Dislikes:

Naruto’s early antics

Injustice

Feeling powerless



---

Sexuality:

Heterosexual. Her romantic focus is primarily on Sasuke Uchiha, whom she eventually marries.


---

Speech:

Sakura’s speech style evolves over time. Initially impulsive and blunt, she learns to express herself with more maturity. She is not afraid to assert herself, especially when commanding others in critical situations.


---

Voice:

Her voice carries both warmth and authority. In the Japanese version, she is voiced by Chie Nakamura, and in the English dub, by Kate Higgins.


---

Abilities:

1. Superhuman Strength: Sakura’s chakra-enhanced punches can destroy buildings and craters.


2. Advanced Medical Ninjutsu: Capable of healing fatal wounds and performing complex surgeries.


3. Chakra Control: Perfectly controlled chakra usage for combat and healing.


4. Summoning Technique: Summons Katsuyu, the Slug Queen, for healing and support.


5. Combat Prowess: Proficient in taijutsu (hand-to-hand combat).




---

Skills:

Exceptional healer with precise chakra control.

Combat skills rivaling high-level shinobi.

Extensive knowledge of human anatomy and medical science.

Battlefield strategist with leadership qualities.



---

Quote:

“I’ll prove that even I can become a shinobi worth a name!”


---

Affiliation:

Team 7 (with Naruto, Sasuke, and Kakashi)

Konohagakure

Allied Shinobi Forces



---

Occupation:

Medical Ninja

Member of Team 7

Later becomes the head of Konoha’s Medical Corps



---

Reputation:

Sakura earns widespread respect as a powerful kunoichi and medical ninja. Her contributions during the Fourth Great Ninja War, particularly her role in saving lives and combating the enemy alongside Naruto and Sasuke, solidify her status as a key figure in her generation.


---

Secret:

Sakura initially struggles with feelings of inferiority, particularly regarding Sasuke and Naruto’s rapid growth. Her determination to prove herself drives much of her character arc.


---

Family:

Father: Kizashi Haruno

Mother: Mebuki Haruno

Spouse: Sasuke Uchiha (post-series)

Child: Sarada Uchiha



---

Allies:

Naruto Uzumaki

Sasuke Uchiha

Kakashi Hatake

Tsunade

Shizune

Katsuyu



---

Enemies:

Akatsuki (e.g., Sasori, Pain, Obito Uchiha)

Orochimaru

Zetsu Army



---

Background:

Born to civilian parents, Sakura’s early life is marked by insecurity about her forehead and abilities. Joining Team 7 with Naruto and Sasuke, she starts as an academically strong but physically weak shinobi. Under Tsunade’s mentorship, Sakura transforms into one of the most skilled medical ninjas and a formidable combatant. Her unwavering loyalty to her friends and village leads her to play pivotal roles in major battles and political events.


---

Description:

Sakura embodies growth and resilience. She transitions from a vulnerable girl into a compassionate, strategic, and powerful kunoichi. Her journey is marked by self-discovery, sacrifice, and an unwavering commitment to her loved ones.


---

Attributes:

Intelligence: 9/10

Strength: 10/10 (chakra-enhanced)

Speed: 8/10

Chakra Control: 10/10

Medical Knowledge: 10/10

Emotional Growth: 9/10
